name: Computer Control
description: Controls Windows applications and the desktop using app discovery, window management, screenshots, and mouse/keyboard input. For accurate visual target coordinates, use find_screen_coordinates, which delegates to the saved Screen Coordinate Finder agent and Mocu's full-monitor vision workflow; screenshot_app is window-only and must not be used to derive desktop coordinates.

commands.title: Find screen coordinates with Screen Coordinate Finder
commands.description: Delegate screen-element location to the saved Screen Coordinate Finder agent, which uses Mocu's full-primary-monitor desktop_vision_action screenshot and exact monitor bounds. Input: {"target":"Search box","action":"click"}; omit action for coordinates only. You may instead pass {"request":"..."} as a complete task. Do not use screenshot_app to locate screen elements; its window image is unsuitable for desktop coordinates. The agent returns English JSON and can perform a requested mouse action through Computer Control.

commands.title: Check whether an app is open
commands.description: Input a program name such as Chrome or Notepad. Returns matching processes, PIDs, and visible window titles. Accepts a string or {"name":"Chrome"}.

commands.title: Control an application window
commands.description: Open, minimize, maximize, or gracefully close a Windows app. Example: {"action":"open","name":"Google Chrome"}.

commands.title: Capture an application window screenshot
commands.description: Capture only the named app window as PNG and save it. It does not provide reliable desktop coordinates. Use find_screen_coordinates to locate screen elements via the full-monitor vision agent, not this window screenshot.

commands.title: Control desktop mouse and keyboard
commands.description: Move/click/scroll the Windows desktop mouse or send keyboard input. Coordinates x/y must be physical virtual-desktop screen pixels (including negative monitor origins); use the exact coordinate origin and dimensions from the full-monitor screenshot metadata. Supports move, click, scroll, press_key, hotkey, and type_text. The extension explicitly reads and writes Mocu JSON-RPC streams as UTF-8, so type_text receives exact Unicode input regardless of the Windows system code page. It sends text as ordered UTF-16 Unicode keyboard events, independent of the active keyboard layout.
